_meta.method: OpenStreetMap Overpass (overpass-api.de, nwr name-regex query within Pompeii park bbox [40.745,14.478,40.757,14.500] plus two follow-up regex queries for Forum/Thermopolium terms and for Villa dei Misteri outside the bbox), cross-checked against Wikidata P625 for major corrections (Jupiter Q3309400, Venus in the Shell Q27685715, Bakery of Popidius Priscus Q27686667, Triangular Forum Q3748439, Forum of Pompeii Q3748443) and against content/research/<id>.md Identity sections. Distances computed via haversine on the corrected route order 0(optional)->1->...->24.

villa-mysteries.source: OSM way 1230956516 'Villa dei Misteri' (building footprint centroid)
villa-mysteries.note: Refined only slightly (~3 m) from prior Wikipedia-infobox value; effectively confirmed. Lies west of the query bbox (14.478 W) because it is genuinely extra-moenia (outside the city walls), not a GPS error.

marina-gate.note: confirmed - exact match to existing value (OSM node is the same source originally used).

apollo.note: Upgraded approx->exact: OSM surveyed way matches prior Wikipedia-infobox estimate within ~1 m.

forum.note: confirmed - Wikidata value matches existing value within <1 m. No plain 'Foro' feature in OSM for this bbox; plaza-centroid so kept approx.

jupiter.source: OSM way 240715566 'Tempio di Giove (VII.8.1)'; cross-checked Wikidata Q3309400 (40.7499,14.4845)
jupiter.note: CORRECTED. Prior value (40.755556,14.490278) was ~830 m NE of the Forum and contradicted every source's 'north end of the Forum' placement (flagged as a conflict in the research file). Current Wikidata Q3309400 actually reads 40.7499,14.4845 (the research file's cited 40.755556,14.490278 does not match live Wikidata - likely a stale/mistyped DMS-to-decimal conversion). OSM and Wikidata now agree to ~10 m. High confidence.

macellum.note: confirmed - matches prior Wikidata-sourced value within ~2 m.

basilica.note: Upgraded approx->exact: OSM matches the prior Wikidata decimal value within ~5 m.

antiquarium.note: Refined ~27 m from prior Wikidata point. Kept approx: multi-room building, node is a representative entrance-area point.

tragic-poet.note: confirmed - matches prior value within ~9 m.

faun.note: confirmed - matches prior value within ~14 m. Kept approx: house spans a full insula (~3000 m2), single point is a centroid.

vettii.note: confirmed - matches prior value within ~3 m.

thermopolium.note: CORRECTED. Prior value was explicitly a placeholder (the Forum Baths' Wikidata point across the street, since the research file found no direct point for VI.8.9). OSM now has the actual VI.8.9 building tagged by that exact address, ~37 m from the placeholder. Cross-check: OSM 'Terme del Foro (VII.5.2)' way (40.7503359,14.4841235, the Forum Baths) sits ~44 m away, consistent with the two being across Via delle Terme from each other as expected. High confidence.

lupanar.note: Upgraded approx->exact: matches prior Wikidata-sourced value within ~2 m and correctly identifies the famous brothel at VII.12.18 (a second OSM feature tagged 'Lupanare (VII.6.35)' near the Forum is a different, unrelated building and was not used).

central-baths.note: Upgraded approx->exact: matches prior Wikidata insula-level point within ~9 m.

chaste-lovers.note: Optional stop, upgraded approx->exact: matches prior value within ~9 m.

bakery.source: OSM way 1086248713 'Panificio di Popidius Priscus (VII.2.22)'; cross-checked Wikidata Q27686667 (40.75088123,14.48571200)
bakery.note: CORRECTED. Prior value (40.75,14.4861) was explicitly flagged in the research file as Pompeii's whole-site reference point (no building-level geocode had been found). OSM and Wikidata now independently agree on the actual VII.2.22 bakery building to within ~1 m of each other. Falls inside the task's expected 'Via degli Augustali / Vicolo Storto' area. High confidence.

fullonica.note: Upgraded approx->exact: matches prior Wikidata-sourced value within ~3 m.

menander.note: Upgraded approx->exact: matches prior DMS-converted value within ~10 m.

triangular-forum.note: confirmed unchanged - Wikidata matches the existing value within ~25 m. An OSM way (id 1363332206) for the same feature centers ~80 m further southwest (likely the full trapezoidal precinct centroid vs. the propylon/temple area used here); Wikidata/original point kept as the more tour-relevant anchor near the entrance and Doric Temple.

large-theatre.note: confirmed - matches prior value within ~3 m.

quadriporticus.note: confirmed - matches prior value within ~4 m.

octavius-quartio.note: Refined ~34 m from prior value (garden feature point vs. house-centroid estimate). Kept approx: point is the garden, not a surveyed house-entrance node.

venus-shell.source: OSM way 59559263 'Casa della Venere in Conchiglia (II.3.3)'; cross-checked Wikidata Q27685715 (40.7519567,14.4927226)
venus-shell.note: CORRECTED. Prior value (40.751333,14.486788) was ~480 m west of Octavius Quartio, which the research file itself flagged as inconsistent with II.3.3 adjoining II.2.2. OSM and Wikidata now independently agree (within ~16 m of each other) on a point immediately next to Octavius Quartio's garden, matching the task's expected ~40.7513,14.4925 area. High confidence.

fugitives.note: Upgraded approx->exact: matches prior Wikipedia-centroid value within ~8 m.

amphitheatre.note: confirmed - matches prior value within ~10 m.

palaestra.note: confirmed - matches prior value within ~9 m.
